viewportMatrix.name: desktop-reference
viewportMatrix.comparison: Run measured webpage_evaluate against web-clone-source/reference.png after each region replacement.

viewportMatrix.name: mobile-review
viewportMatrix.comparison: Capture and inspect the root app at this viewport; use measured comparison when matching reference evidence exists, otherwise record the evidence gap.

viewportMatrix.name: wide-review
viewportMatrix.comparison: Capture and inspect the root app at this viewport; use measured comparison when matching reference evidence exists, otherwise record the evidence gap.

visualIteration.rule: Use the desktop-reference viewport as the primary measured comparison after each region replacement. Use responsive-review viewports for screenshot review and measured comparison when matching reference evidence exists; otherwise record the missing evidence instead of claiming responsive parity.

rules: Use sourceData.ts and framework components as the editable implementation surface.
Do not render reference.png, screenshot files, base64 payloads, or hidden semantic coverage layers as the clone.
Use reference.png only as visual validation evidence with webpage_evaluate or overlay comparison.
